pluginText.pf.license: {"need":"a state medical license for each OB-GYN doctor and nurse practitioner, and the practice's registration where the state's rules require it; a state or federal registration for any in-office procedure or ultrasound the state names; a home-visit license where the state requires one for care at the patient's home","who":"both: the practice, and each clinician who sees patients","ask":"optional, for the owner's own page: each clinician's license number, the practice's registration; nothing is needed to book","check":"none: Rosie never looks up a license, certificate or training record; the owner keeps them current","scope":"a clinician sees only the kinds of care their license covers; a procedure or ultrasound is done only by a clinician the state names for it; Rosie never gives medical advice","blocks":"none from Rosie: no booking is held or refused because a license can't be read","renewals":"none kept by Rosie: the owner keeps the renewal dates","insurance":"the owner's own liability insurance; Rosie never verifies it","background":"the practice's own background checks for staff who go into a patient's home, where its rules or the state require them; Rosie never verifies them","telehealth":"a video visit counts as at the office; the clinician's license for the patient's state applies"}

pluginText.pf.questions: {"beforeTimes":["the kind of visit (new, checkup, prenatal, birth control, a home visit)","whether it's a video visit (it counts as at the office)","a health plan or self-pay (only the plan's name here)","for a teen (under 18): whether the teen books alone, where the state's rules allow it","for a home visit: the town, and whether the patient can come to the door"],"afterTime":["any access need","a note for the clinician: a hard exam, or a past faint at a visit","for a home visit: the address, parking and any gate code"],"securePage":["the health history for a new patient (on the secure page only)","the plan's member details","date of birth (every visit is matched to the patient by two details)","medicines that matter, only where the clinician asks","a pelvic exam's consent and a chaperone's OK, where the visit has one","who may get the results: the patient; a parent or guardian for a minor only where the state's rules allow it"],"whoMayBook":"an adult for themselves; a parent or guardian for a child; a teen books alone only where the state's rules allow it; a partner or another adult may join with the patient's own OK on the secure page"}
pluginText.pf.safety: {"stop":[{"words":"heavy bleeding with dizziness or fainting, severe belly or pelvic pain, chest pain, trouble breathing, or a sudden severe headache, during pregnancy or after birth","say":"Call 911 now.","booking":"no booking"}],"goOn":[{"words":"light spotting or a missed period while pregnant, or a question about a medicine","what":"the booking goes on, with the soonest same-day time; the nurse line calls within the hour; never answered by Rosie"},{"words":"fever or worse pain after a procedure","what":"the booking goes on as urgent; the nurse line calls at once; the clinician is told"},{"words":"feels unsafe at home or with a partner","what":"the family-violence line's words come first, then the booking goes on privately; the team is told that day, with no detail in any text"}],"fasting":"none for these visits; a lab test has its own prep from the office's lab","always":"the generic screen: danger to life, fire, gas, a medical emergency or self-harm → call 911 or 988, and no booking"}
pluginText.pf.first_steps: {"steps":[{"name":"A health history for a new patient","when":"on the secure page before the first visit","result":"done: booked; not done: the desk asks once, then the visit waits"},{"name":"Consent for a pelvic exam or procedure","when":"signed on the secure page before the visit","result":"signed: booked; not signed: the visit goes ahead without that exam"},{"name":"The plan check","when":"by the desk before the visit","result":"covered, part covered (the share shown), or not covered (self-pay); where the plan's rules require it, a notice of likely non-coverage is signed before the visit"},{"name":"A teen's visit","when":"the teen books alone only where the state's rules allow it; a parent or guardian's OK otherwise","result":"OK on file: booked; no OK: the visit waits for a parent or guardian"}],"prep":"for the reminder: photo ID, the plan card, a list of medicines, and any old records; a urine or blood sample may be asked for at the visit; for a home visit, clear the path to the room"}
pluginText.pf.visit: {"checkIn":"at the front desk: the code, then photo ID and the plan card checked against the secure page; a chaperone is offered for any pelvic exam; a home visit: the code at the door, then photo ID","changes":"the clinician adds a test, an ultrasound or an in-office procedure: priced first, with the self-pay price shown; a placement waits for a written OK; nothing else is sold at a visit","cantGoAhead":"no ID, a pelvic exam with no consent, bleeding that is an emergency (911 words first), or the patient feels faint: the visit stops; a new visit is booked with no charge","done":"the code, then DONE from the clinician; the bill is the practice's; results go to the patient's secure page or the patient portal; Rosie keeps only booking records","rejected":"a lab sample that can't be used: the patient is offered a new draw with no charge, by the secure page","dropOff":"none: the office takes no drop-offs; a sample is sent by the office's own lab"}
pluginText.pf.money: {"before":"new patient visits, checkups and procedures take nothing when booking; a self-pay video follow-up is paid in full when booking; a card may be saved for a no-show fee only if the owner turns it on","insurance":"health plans: only the plan's name before times; member details on the secure page; the practice bills the plan; the patient's share is billed after the plan pays (Rosie texts the bill); a notice of likely non-coverage is signed before the visit where the plan's rules require it","thirdParty":"none: an employer or family member is never the payer through Rosie","estimate":"a self-pay patient gets a written price estimate before a procedure, where the rules require it","caps":"deposit cap: from the state form","fees":"the owner's no-show fee (example $20), a card saved only when the owner turns it on, never for a fee-free patient; a home visit's visit fee is billed after, and only if agreed when booking","refunds":"the owner decides refunds; Rosie never refunds on its own","tips":"none","tax":"no tax on health care"}
pluginText.pf.messages: {"never":"the diagnosis, a pregnancy, the names of tests or procedures, results, medicines, ID numbers and plan details never go in a text: only the secure page; texts say only the practice's name, the day, the time and the place","staffTexts":"the owner and staff get the patient's initials, the time and the room; no health details","results":"a text says only 'your results are ready on the secure page' or 'your doctor will call you'","languages":"English and Spanish","minors":"a teen's and a child's texts go to the parent or guardian, where the state's rules say so"}
pluginText.pf.staff: {"licenses":"each doctor and nurse practitioner holds a state license; the practice keeps its own record (optional, never looked up by Rosie)","skills":"obstetrics, gynecology, prenatal and postpartum care, contraception and IUD placement, in-office ultrasound, chaperones, Spanish","supervision":"the practice's medical director; a new clinician works under a senior one until signed off","oks":"the owner OKs new patients, refunds and any procedure price","standIn":"a patient may ask for a named clinician; if that clinician can't take it, the desk offers the next open day or another clinician with the skill; a pelvic exam is done only by a clinician with a chaperone's OK","away":"only clinicians cleared for home visits go to a patient's home"}
pluginText.pf.rules: {"privacy":"a health privacy agreement (a business associate agreement) is signed before going live; health details only on the secure page","records":"medical records are the practice's own, kept as long as the state's rules require; Rosie keeps only booking records","consent":"a pelvic exam or procedure needs the patient's own consent on the secure page; a teen's consent follows the state's rules","showFacts":"the practice's name and address; no license claim unless the owner gives it as the owner's own word","results":"results go to the patient's secure page or portal within the time the health privacy rules set","reviews":"a rating is never asked for health work (sensitive); any reply never confirms the person was a patient"}
pluginText.pf.edges: {"fasting":"none for these visits","noOrder":"a referral the plan needs: the desk asks the plan while the patient waits, or the visit moves with no fee","rejected":"a lab sample that can't be used: a free new draw","critical":"a result that needs same-day care: the clinician calls the patient, never a text","faint":"a patient feels faint at a visit: the visit stops, the patient lies down, 911 if hurt; the owner is told with no health detail","kids":"a teen or child is seen with a parent or guardian, as the state's rules say","mobile":"a homebound patient doesn't come to the door: the clinician calls, then the contact on the booking; the owner decides a welfare check; no fee while the patient's safety is unknown","drugTest":"none","paternity":"none","results":"results to the patient; never to the payer","other":"all other edge cases the generic way"}
